note: Frames are 60 fps from the effect's start, which is the hit.
story: A punchy shoulder barge. At contact a 2-frame white core pops with rays and a dark halo behind it; a ring bursts outward from the hit and line bursts fly and stop; then a few embers rise and fade.

beats.name: Hit
beats.intent: a white core pops for 2 frames over a dark halo

beats.name: Burst
beats.intent: a ring bursts out from the hit; lines shoot out and stop

beats.name: Tail
beats.intent: a few embers rise and fade
